title: Rebuild the shift mechanism
completeness: Complete bounded bench operation from the declared entry state to the declared exit state. Whole-bike access and downstream engine closure are separate dependencies.

source.review_note: All cited operation pages visually reviewed. General symbols and conditional torque rules retained.

applicability.included: Exact US2026 YZ450F standard stock components only

required_tools.name: Torque wrench accurate at10/12/30Nm; seal driver

required_parts.name: Engine oil, lithium-soap grease and LOCTITE

preflight: Clutch idle gear removed; selector exposed; transmission installed for final check.
entry_state: Clutch idle gear removed; selector exposed; transmission installed for final check.
exit_state: Shift shaft/selector/pedal installed and function checked; clutch/cover closure remains.
critical_stop_conditions: Any required measurement unresolved or replacement criteria not satisfied.
Unidentified diagram orientation, missing parts, damage or abnormal binding.

material_policy.LT: Locking agent (LOCTITE) per PDF7. Grade unspecified by this manual; no grade inferred.
material_policy.lubrication: Follow each explicit E/M/LS/S application; general dry torque does not override a lubricated joint.

steps.title: Confirm shift-mechanism access
steps.instruction: Start with the clutch idle gear removed and right-side shift mechanism exposed. Retain the pedal alignment marks if the pedal is still fitted; remove its bolt/pedal before withdrawing the shaft.
verification: Idle gear removed; pedal marks retained.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Remove the shaft and selector parts
steps.instruction: Withdraw shift shaft, collar and spring; retain the roller. Remove shift-guide bolts and lift guide/shift-lever assembly together, retaining both pawls, pins and springs by location. Turn the segment counterclockwise to its stop and loosen its bolt without impact. Remove segment, stopper lever/collar and spring.
verification: Shaft/selector parts labeled; no impact on segment.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Inspect every selector part
steps.instruction: Replace bent/damaged/worn shift shaft or spring. Inspect guide, lever, both pawls/pins/springs and stopper lever for damage/wear; replace defective parts. Replace a broken stopper spring. Record the assessment.
verification: Selector inspection and replacement list saved.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Install the stopper and segment
steps.instruction: Fit stopper spring, collar and lever in the shown arrangement; tighten stopper bolt10Nm with LOCTITE. Push the stopper lever down and align segment projections with drum slits; install segment bolt30Nm without impact.
verification: Stopper10Nm, segment30Nm and projection/slit alignment recorded.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Build and fit the shift lever
steps.instruction: Oil the two springs, pawl pins and pawls. Fit them in the illustrated lever pockets, then install lever into guide. Fit both together and tighten shift-guide bolts10Nm with LOCTITE.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Install shaft and new seal
steps.instruction: Fit dowel, roller, shaft spring and collar in the illustrated locations. Oil the shaft and install it with the spring engaging as shown. Fit a new shift-shaft seal at0–1.0mm illustrated depth and lubricate its lip with lithium-soap grease.
verification: Shaft spring engagement and new seal depth recorded.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Refit the marked pedal and check movement
steps.instruction: Align the punch marks on shaft and pedal; tighten pedal bolt12Nm. Operate the selector while turning the transmission by hand, checking smooth return and gear selection before the idle gear and covers are installed.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

runtime_integration_requirement: Enforce entry state and record_required. Completion certifies this bounded operation only; no automatic completion of upstream/downstream work.
